notes: Publisher TOC is the article list. Non-research items are kept and flagged is_research=0.

Author names come from the TOC when present, else from OpenAlex names recorded in the collector registry (name only; no person_id), else from a journal-side OpenAlex work harvest by DOI (names only; no person_id), else from Crossref by DOI (authors_source=crossref), else, for Quantitative Economics items whose names were taken from the official Econometric Society article page before a DOI was available, from that page (authors_source=toc_official_qe). Where no TOC name was present and the names were read from the printed byline on the official publisher article page (one Journal of Financial Econometrics 2025 item whose DOI was not yet in Crossref or OpenAlex), that page is the source (authors_source=publisher_page; names only, no affiliations or person_id) and its public article URL fills publisher_url; it is counted under source_other in authors_missing_by_journal_year.csv. Registry names that were ingested from the Crossref fill keep authors_source=crossref.
AER Insights begins in 2019, so 2010–2018 have 48 journals.

For 2010–2011, items without a TOC name take names from a journal-side OpenAlex work harvest by DOI (authors_source=openalex; names only, no person_id). Where the DOI resolved in OpenAlex only to a merged working-paper record with a matching title, that record supplied the names. Research items with no DOI (Quantitative Economics and Review of Economics and Statistics, 2010–2011) are kept; some have no names.
Internal person_ids, conflicts, and QS handoffs are excluded.
